## Hand-written notes (preserved verbatim)

<!-- notes:begin -->
A SHA recorded beside a modified file can be recomputed by the same attacker, so a static bundle check is not an SC-27 solution. The scenario needs an independent trust root and signed or protected attestations before any runtime security claim; `SC27Chain` models the independent anchor, and no runtime anchor exists.
<!-- notes:end -->
